Title: Instagram head Adam Mosseri to testify at Meta child social media addiction trial
description: Instagram's chief executive, Adam Mosseri, is expected to take the witness stand on Tuesday in a trial ‌over whether Meta Platforms designed Instagram and Facebook to addict children without proper regard ‌for their safety.  Mosseri is a central witness in the lawsuit by 29 U.S. states, in what experts call the biggest legal ​test yet of social media's effects on young users.  Four of the states — California, Colorado, Kentucky and New Jersey — have accused Meta of designing the platforms to hook young users, fueling anxiety, depression and even suicide, while misleading consumers about their safety.
